description: Cross-vault intent / bridge hop profile. Not a privacy pool. Moves value between per-chain Siphon vaults with an honest public bridge leg (Li.Fi-class), then re-enters private notes on the destination vault. NOTE: Solana source vault is PARKED — use solana-wallet-fund-base-v1 (/solana/fundBase/plan) for Phantom→Base.

privacyPhysics.sourceVault: private ZK spend (withdraw) on chain A
privacyPhysics.destinationVault: deposit + ASP screen → private notes on chain B

adapters.role: pluggable settlement for the public hop only

steps: bridge via selected adapter to destination chain/asset
deposit into destination vault with userSalt + precommitment
hop.programVersionBump: required if guest gains bridge-specific limbs later

chainBindings.solana-v1: siphon-vault withdraw → SPL → Li.Fi/Jupiter bridge route
